Image credits

138 photographs and diagrams in the question bank come from Wikimedia Commons. They are stored with the app (12.0 MB in total) so that practice works offline and so a child on a slow connection is never left waiting on another website. Each is listed below with its author and licence. Every other illustration in the app is an inline SVG drawn for this project.
